title: Child support - federal/state framework
facts: Child support orders and the amount owed are primarily determined under state or tribal law, while the federal child-support program supports establishment and enforcement across jurisdictions.
State child-support agencies can assist with locating parents, establishing parentage, establishing or modifying support orders, and enforcing support.
Federal law supports tools including income withholding, tax-refund offset and interstate enforcement, subject to program requirements.
Hanka should not quote a child-support amount or state formula without the relevant state and case facts.
